use_case: Consumer generative AI chatbot used weekly for price suggestions (from sales totals and supplier costs) and personalized offer emails to online customers (from pasted order histories)
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI chatbot vendor (general-purpose large language model, free personal plan); no business terms
data_categories: Before 2026-08-24: customer names, emails, and order histories; sales totals; supplier costs. From 2026-08-24: sales totals, supplier costs, and item data only
consequential_decision_category: None (retail prices and offers; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Owner checks every suggested price against the cost floor, the 10% weekly change cap, and the emergency freeze before entering it in the POS app, and reads every email before sending
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (N44-45-R02); Fla. Stat. 501.160 price gouging during a declared emergency; 7 CFR 278.2(b) SNAP equal treatment; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); the online privacy notice
status: Approved with conditions 2026-09-04 for prices and generic offer copy without customer data; personalized offers from order histories stopped

use_case: Reorder suggestions built into the POS app (vendor sales forecasting feature)
data_categories: Item sales history and stock counts; no customer data
human_in_the_loop: Owner accepts or edits each suggested order before sending it to the distributor
applicable_laws: None specific; covered by the POS app terms
